newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador bank liquidity down 1.21 pct at June 20.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador bank liquidity down 1.21 pct at June 20.

text.p: Ecuador's Central Bank said Tuesday liquidity in the banking system fell 1.21 percent or 242 million sucres to 19.71 billion sucres in the week to June 20.
At the end of May, bank liquidity stood at 19.61 billion sucres.
Total liquidity in the bank sector ended 1996 at 16.99 billion sucres, up 35.8 percent from 1995.
